title: Group Structure from Subgroup and Cyclic Subgroup Counts
summary: For a finite group \(G\), let \(\sub(G)\) be the number of subgroups of \(G\), let \(\cyc(G)\) be the number of cyclic subgroups, and let \(π(G)\) be the number of distinct prime divisors of \(|G|\). We study the normalized counts \(λ(G)=\sub(G)/2^{π(G)}\) and \(η(G)=\cyc(G)/2^{π(G)}\). We prove that \(η(G)<5/4\) or \(λ(G)<3/2\) implies that \(G\) is cyclic of squarefree order. The inequalities \(η(G)<2\) and \(λ(G)<5/2\) each force all Sylow subgroups to be cyclic, and hence imply metacyclicity.
